## Project

Electricity tariffs often combine nonlinear prices with targeted relief, making behavioural and fiscal effects difficult to separate. This project uses experimental variation in subsidies to estimate how households adjust consumption, payment, and theft across the tariff schedule.

<p class="draft-note">Results are not yet available. For updates on this project, <a href="mailto:t.dobermann@lse.ac.uk">get in touch</a>.</p>
